textwithimage.text:
For SMARC 2.0/2.1 Modules

The Embedded Carrierboard MB-COME10-2 is a versatile and compact mini-ITX motherboard designed to work seamlessly with COM Express® Type 10 Mini Modules. This carrier board provides a universal platform for integrating and enhancing the functionality of COM Express® Mini type 10 modules, making it an ideal choice for various industrial and embedded applications.

Key features of the MB-COME10-2 include support for high-resolution displays with options for 1x eDP or 1x LVDS, selectable via a dip switch and panel support signals. It also boasts a low-profile design, which optimizes mechanical and thermal integration.

The carrier board offers high-speed connectivity options, including 1x DP that supports resolutions up to 8K, 1x USB 3.1 Gen2 Type A, and 1x USB 3.1 Gen2 Type C. Networking capabilities are robust, featuring 1x GbE TSN Ethernet and 1x 2.5 GbE TSN Ethernet.

Moreover, the MB-COME10-2 is designed for reliability and longevity, with support for extended temperature ranges. It provides expansion options with M.2 Key B, E, and M slots, ensuring flexibility in configuring the board to meet specific project requirements.

Overall, this mini-ITX carrier board is a dependable and adaptable solution for FPGA engineers seeking a reliable platform for integrating COM Express® Type 10 Mini Modules into their industrial applications. Its rich set of features and robust design make it a valuable tool for various embedded system projects

text.text:
Features

  • Versatile Display Support: Multiple display options with 1x DP, 1x eDP/LVDS, and backlight control/power for high-resolution visuals.

  • High-Speed Connectivity: A range of high-speed interfaces, including USB 3.2 Gen 2, USB Type C, and multiple Ethernet options for efficient data transfer.

  • Expansion Flexibility: M.2 Key E, B, and M slots, along with PCIe x1 and SATA support, enable easy expansion and customization.

  • Robust Industrial Design: Built to withstand harsh environments with extended temperature support, making it suitable for industrial applications.

  • Comprehensive I/O: A rich set of I/O interfaces, including USB, serial ports, CAN, GPIO, and more, ensuring compatibility with various peripherals and sensors

table.text:
Graphics
  • 1x DP
  • 1x HDMI
  • 1x eDP or LVDS + backlight control/power
Communications Interfaces
  • Ethernet - 2x Gigabit Ethernet 
  • USB - 1 USB Type C | 1 USB Type A | 2x USB 2.0
  • CAN - 2x CAN
  • Serial Ports - 5x RS 232 | 1x Multilevel Transceiver
Other Interfaces
  • PCIe - 1x PCIe 
  • SD Card - 1 Micro SD socket
  • I2C
  • Audio - Audio jacks
  • SPI - SPI 
  • M.2 - M.2 Key B,M,E
  • GPIO - 1x GPIO
  • MIPI - 1x MIPI CSI Socket
General
  • Dimensions - 170mm x 170mm
  • Plug-in System - SMARC 2.0/2.1
  • Temperature range - Operating temperature: -20°C...+85°C
  • Power supply - 12 Volt DC, Connector Type MC 1.5/4G-GF-3.5-LR

MB-COME10-1-AA
  • Carrierboard for COM Express type 10 mini modules (with eDP pinout configuration). This version supports eDP/LVDS (no second DP output) and can be used for evaluation and PanelPC integration.

MB-COME10-1-AB
  • Carrierboard for COM Express type 10 mini modules (with eDP pinout configuration). This version supports second DP output (no eDP/LVDS) and can be used for evaluation and BoxPC integration.
